design_brief.description: 3D model of a D-subminiature (DA-15) connector flange with 15-pin interface. Includes a rectangular flange plate sized 39.14 mm x 12.55 mm with 1.12 mm thickness and two mounting holes on a 33.32 mm center-to-center pitch. Pin field represented as 15 header-style pins arranged in 3 rows of 5 (DA-15 pattern) located within the flange outline.

metadata.description: DA-15 D-subminiature connector flange plate with two mounting holes and a simplified 15-pin (3x5) header-style pin field.

primary_dimension.description: Primary anchor dimension (flange width). All other dimensions are derived proportionally from this.

flange_width_mm.description: Flange plate width (X). Tied to primary_dimension.

flange_height_mm.description: Flange plate height (Y), proportional to flange width.

flange_thickness_mm.description: Flange plate thickness (Z), proportional to flange width.

mounting_hole_pitch_mm.description: Center-to-center pitch between the two mounting holes (X), proportional to flange width.

mounting_hole_diameter_mm.description: Mounting hole diameter, proportional to flange width.

pin_pitch_mm.description: Pin pitch along X within a row, proportional to flange width.

row_pitch_mm.description: Row-to-row pitch along Y, proportional to flange width.

pin_length_mm.description: Pin length (Z), proportional to flange width.

pin_width_mm.description: Square pin cross-section width, proportional to flange width.

edge_margin_mm.description: General margin from flange edges for internal features, proportional to flange width.

overlap_mm.description: Small overlap to guarantee solid connectivity between pins and plate.

hole_clearance_z_mm.description: Extra height for hole-cutting cylinder beyond plate thickness to ensure clean subtraction.
